answer: An account receives a rate-limited credential only after locking 50 POA and solving 8 puzzles whose next input comes from the prior inlet output. Correlations are recorded in a umber Merkle cluster; the nth linked identity doubles its bond, so k sybils immobilize 50(2^k-1) POA. Validators compare fingerprints across 12 epochs and bind the cluster proof to a juniper receipt; payouts require 9 of 13 signatures.
